prompt: When does NIST recommend holding the lessons-learned review?

choices.text: Within several days of the end
choices.why: Right. People still remember, and recovery is over.

choices.text: Only if the incident was serious
choices.why: Every incident earns one, even a short one.

choices.text: At the end of the year
During containment, while the details are still fresh in everybody's mind
choices.why: Too early: the team is busy containing.

To keep the meeting on questions, with no side to defend
Because the lead must not attend
To decide who was at fault

the owners of the systems involved
the ANPD

prompt: Why is a blameless review more accurate, not only kinder?

choices.text: The law forbids blaming employees for security incidents of any kind
Nobody is ever at fault
choices.why: It looks at the system, not at innocence.

choices.text: It is shorter
People who are not blamed describe what they did
choices.why: Right. The others describe what they should have done.
